PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AdmissionFree.en: Admission is free for everyone\ntoday. Please enjoy the MUSEUM!
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AdmissionFree.fr: L'entrée est gratuite pour tous\naujourd'hui. Profitez du MUSÉE !

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AerodactylFoss.en: AERODACTYL Fossil\nA primitive and rare POKéMON.
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AerodactylFoss.fr: Fossile de PTÉRA Un POKéMON rare et\nancien.

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AmberContainsG.en: AMBER contains the genetic matter\nof ancient POKéMON.\pThere's a LAB somewhere trying to\nresurrect POKéMON from AMBER.
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AmberContainsG.fr: Dans un certain labo, on essaie de\nrégénérer les anciens POKéMON\pgrâce à leur information génétique\ncontenue dans de l'AMBRE.

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AmberIsFossili.en: AMBER is actually sap, that gooey\nstuff that oozes from trees.\pThe ancient sap fossilized over\ntime to become rock-hard AMBER.
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AmberIsFossili.fr: L'AMBRE est en fait de la sève\ntombée des arbres.\pAvec le temps, la sève se fossilise\npour devenir de l'AMBRE.

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_BeautifulPiece.en: There is a beautiful piece of\nAMBER in a clear gold color.
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_BeautifulPiece.fr: Il y a un beau morceau d'AMBRE d'un\néclat doré! !

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_DoYouKnowWhatA.en: You can't sneak in the back way!\nNice try, kid, but no.\pOh, whatever!\nDo you know what AMBER is?
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_DoYouKnowWhatA.fr: Ne te cache pas dans l'ombre !\pEnfin, si ça t'amuse ! Au fait,\nsais-tu ce que c'est l'AMBRE ?

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_DontHaveSpaceF.en: You don't have space for this.

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_GetOldAmberChe.fr: Chut ! Va faire examiner ce morceau\nd'AMBRE !

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_Its50YForChild.en: Yes, yes.\nIt's ¥50 for a child's ticket.\pWould you like to come in?
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_Its50YForChild.fr: 50¥ le ticket pour un enfant.\pVoulez-vous entrer ?

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_KabutopsFossil.en: KABUTOPS Fossil\nA primitive and rare POKéMON.
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_KabutopsFossil.fr: Fossile du KABUTOPS Un POKéMON rare\net ancien.

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_MonKabuto.en: KABUTO: Kabu!\nA revived fossil, warming up\lnext to the lava.
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_MonKabuto.fr: KABUTO : Kabu ! Un fossile ravivé,\nqui se réchauffe près de la lave.

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_ReceivedOldAmb.en: {PLAYER} received the OLD AMBER\nfrom the man.

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_ShouldBeGratef.en: I should be grateful for my long\nlife.\pNever did I think I would get to\nsee the bones of a dragon!
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_ShouldBeGratef.fr: Je ne pensais pas que je pourrais\nvivre suffisamment vieux pour\ppouvoir voir des os de dragon.

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_WantYouToGetAm.en:
Ssh! Listen, I need to share a
secret with someone.\pI think that this chunk of AMBER
contains POKéMON DNA!\pIt would be a shattering scientific
breakthrough if POKéMON could be\lresurrected from it.\pBut, my colleagues just ignore
what I have to say.\pSo, I have a favor to ask!\pI want you to get this examined at
a POKéMON LAB somewhere.
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_WantYouToGetAm.fr:
Je crois qu'il y a des traces d'ADN
de POKéMON dans ce morceau d'ambre.\pÇa serait une avancée scientifique
incroyable si on pouvait\prégénérer un POKéMON à partir de
cette pierre ! Non ? Hein ?\pMais personne ne m'écoute !\pJ'ai une faveur à te demander !\pApporte ça à mon LABO POKéMON pour
l'examiner !

PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_WeHaveTwoFossi.en: The thieves walked right past our\nfossils. They wanted only the\pPYROPE.
PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_WeHaveTwoFossi.fr: Les voleurs sont passés devant nos\nfossiles. Ils voulaient que le\lPYROPE.
